title: How we cut sign-in latency by 84%
summary: Moving session storage to Redis took p95 token issuance from 610ms to 41ms.
body: The old session table was the bottleneck: every refresh took a row lock that the dual-writer held for the duration of the replica round trip. Moving to Redis removed the lock entirely.
author: 1d9f4a02-7b36-4c81-a5e0-92f7c103b846

title: Offline-first field reports in Orbit 4.8
summary: Technicians can now file reports without a signal and replay them on reconnect.
body: The offline queue writes to a local store and replays on reconnect with idempotency keys, so a duplicate replay never creates a second report.
author: 5c07e83b-1f42-4d69-b3a8-07e5d91c264f

title: Row level security, the practical version
summary: Policies against auth.uid() that survive contact with a real product.
body: Write policies for the request role first, then the row owner. Service credentials bypass every policy, so keep them out of client bundles.
author: 1d9f4a02-7b36-4c81-a5e0-92f7c103b846

title: Dual-writer cutover: what we would do differently
summary: A retrospective on the session-store migration, including the parts that hurt.
body: Queue depth was the only signal that mattered, and we did not alert on it until the second week.
author: 5c07e83b-1f42-4d69-b3a8-07e5d91c264f

title: Passkeys are coming to Orbit
summary: WebAuthn sign-in enters beta next month.
body: Passkeys remove the password from the critical path entirely. The rollout starts with iOS and the web app.
author: 9e63b1d5-4a70-42fc-8b19-c05f7e2a3846

title: We are hiring a platform engineer
summary: Join the team behind the auth and billing services.
body: You will own the session layer end to end, from the Redis cluster to the mobile SDK.
author: 1d9f4a02-7b36-4c81-a5e0-92f7c103b846

title: Migrating off the legacy CSV importer
summary: Retired after the 2025 migration; kept for the schema mapping appendix.
body: The importer served 400 customers before it was replaced by the streaming ingest pipeline.
author: 9e63b1d5-4a70-42fc-8b19-c05f7e2a3846

title: Advisory: refresh-token reuse detection
summary: Reusing a rotated refresh token now invalidates the whole token family.
body: If a token is presented twice, every descendant is revoked and the session must re-authenticate. No customer data was affected.
author: 1d9f4a02-7b36-4c81-a5e0-92f7c103b846
